name: Intra Balance Cancellation 7
definition: Provides the cancellation requests data in the report.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account to or from which a cash entry is made.

CashAccountServicer.name: Cash Account Servicer
CashAccountServicer.definition: Party that manages the cash account on behalf of the account owner, that is manages the registration and booking of entries on the account, calculates balances on the account and provides information about the account.

ProcessingStatus.name: Processing Status
ProcessingStatus.definition: Status and status reason of the transaction.

Cancellation.name: Cancellation
Cancellation.definition: Further details of the individual intrabalance cancellation transaction.

CashAccountRule.definition: CashAccount must be present or Cancellation(*)/CashAccount must be present, but not both.

CashAccountOwnerRule.definition: CashAccountOwner must be present or Cancellation(*)/AccountOwner must be present, but not both.

ProcessingStatusRule.definition: ProcessingStatus must be present or Cancellation(*)/ProcessingStatus must be present, but not both.

CashAccountServicerRule.definition: CashAccountServicer must be present or Cancellation(*)/AccountOwner must be present, but not both.
